hypothesis: Replacing the unobserved four-byte tail of every E1<10,96> cell by the ABI-minimal E1<10,92> representation preserves the exact archive at fixed cell count while lowering resident memory enough to support a higher-capacity dense composition.
interfaces_exposed: FXCM A10 cell object representation, field offsets, allocation bytes, and exact probability trajectory
kill_condition: Retire the tight layout unchanged on any sizeof or offset mismatch, checksum misalignment, archive difference at fixed cell count, roundtrip or determinism failure, or failure to reduce measured or exact allocated memory. Do not tune intermediate widths.
promotion_condition: Require the host ABI verifier, exact 250K roundtrip, byte-identical archive versus the frozen A10 parent, deterministic second archive, strictly lower peak RSS or allocation accounting, and no program-size regression beyond 1024 bytes. Only identity authorizes composition with DRB-1.
retired_neighborhoods: Distinct from associativity tuning: A and every logical field remain fixed; only provably unobserved tail padding is removed.
title: SLC-1 tight ninety-two-byte FXCM A10 cell
